intro: Kunming rewards visitors with mild weather, lakeside scenery, diverse cuisine and easy links to Southeast Asia. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro has five lines, runs about 07:00-22:00, fares ¥2-10; ticket machines take paper cash only.
Line 6 links Changshui Airport to East Bus Station, then Line 3 into downtown.
City buses cost ¥2 and run roughly 06:00-22:00; a bus card cuts fares to about ¥0.90.
Taxis start at ¥8 plus a ¥3 fuel surcharge; insist on the meter.
Ride apps like Didi work; WeChat and Alipay are widely used for payments.
Bikes rent at hostels for about ¥20 a day; shared e-bikes cost about ¥2.5 for the first 20 min.

shilin.name: Shilin Stone Forest
shilin.price_text: ≈ CNY 130–175 entry; check on the day
shilin.tip: Go early to beat the tour buses and wear shoes with grip on the limestone paths.

yuantong.name: Yuantong Temple
yuantong.tip: The oldest temple in Kunming; walk down to the pond hall and keep voices low.

greenlake.name: Green Lake Park
greenlake.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
greenlake.tip: Come early to watch locals dance, sing and practise tai chi around the lake.

chagee.name: Chagee
chagee.tip: A local milk-tea chain; order the classic milk tea and ask for less sugar.

zhuanxin.name: Zhuanxin Wet Market
zhuanxin.price_text: Free to enter; pay per item
zhuanxin.tip: Try fresh mushrooms, rice noodles and fruit; bring small cash and go before noon.

xishan.name: Xishan (Western Hills) viewpoint
xishan.price_text: ≈ CNY 25–40 for the cable car or park; check on the day
xishan.tip: Climb or take the cable car for views over Dianchi Lake; bring a jacket.

dianchi.name: Dianchi Lake promenade and Haigeng Dam
dianchi.tip: Walk the dam in winter to see the flocks of seagulls from Siberia.

guandu.name: Guandu Old Town
guandu.price_text: Free to walk; small fees at some temples
guandu.tip: A quieter old quarter with temples and snack stalls; go on a weekday.

cuihu_food.name: Yunnan rice noodle lunch (guoqiao mixian)
cuihu_food.tip: Crossing-the-bridge noodles arrive with hot broth; add the raw items in the order staff show you.

flower_market.name: Dounan Flower Market
flower_market.price_text: Free to enter; pay per bunch
flower_market.tip: Asia's big flower market; go early morning for the auction atmosphere and cheap bouquets.

yuantong_walk.name: Wenlin Street and Kunming old-town walk
yuantong_walk.tip: Wander the lanes between Green Lake and Yuantong Temple for cafés and old houses.

yunnan_museum.name: Yunnan Provincial Museum
yunnan_museum.price_text: Free with ID; some special shows charge
yunnan_museum.tip: Good for Yunnan's ethnic cultures and bronze drums; bring your passport for entry.

ethnic_village.name: Yunnan Nationalities Village
ethnic_village.price_text: ≈ CNY 90 entry; check on the day
ethnic_village.tip: A lakeside park of reconstructed ethnic villages; good for families, allow half a day.

bird_lake.name: Seagull watching at Haigeng Park
bird_lake.price_text: Free; bird food a few CNY
bird_lake.tip: Buy bird food from vendors and hold it up; the gulls land on your hand.

tea_horse.name: Tea Horse Road day tour
tea_horse.tip: Book through your hotel and confirm pickup, lunch and any shopping stops are clear.

stone_forest_tour.name: Shilin day trip from Kunming
stone_forest_tour.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–300 plus entry; check on the day
stone_forest_tour.tip: Saves the bus hassle; confirm whether the Stone Forest ticket is included.

nanping.name: Nanping Street pedestrian area
nanping.price_text: Free to walk; pay per snack
nanping.tip: Central shopping street with snack stalls; good for an easy evening stroll.

cuihu_cafe.name: Green Lake café stop
cuihu_cafe.tip: Sit by the lake after the park walk; many small cafés line the streets nearby.

jindian.name: Jindian (Golden Temple) Park
jindian.price_text: ≈ CNY 25 entry; check on the day
jindian.tip: A bronze temple on a wooded hill north of town; combine with a walk in the pine forest.

railway_station_food.name: Kunming Railway Station noodle stalls
railway_station_food.tip: Handy before a train; eat where locals queue and check prices first.

south_station.name: Kunming South Station transfer stop
south_station.price_text: Free to enter; pay for food
south_station.tip: Far from the centre; allow extra time and buy snacks before the security check.

stays.why: Walk to Green Lake Park, the old streets and markets. Metro nearby for trips out of town.
Handy for early trains and buses onward. Busy, plain streets; good budget rooms.
Lake views, quieter evenings and easy access to the western hills. Far from the centre.
Best for high-speed trains to other provinces. Little to see nearby; a sleep-and-go base.

food: Try Crossing-the-Bridge rice noodles (过桥米线), the city's signature bowl. Expect roughly ¥20–40.
Wild mushrooms are a summer treat. Eat them only at busy, reputable restaurants and always cooked through.
Snack streets near the old town and university area sell grilled skewers, fried potatoes and flower cakes.
Flower cakes (鲜花饼) and Pu'er tea make easy, light gifts. Buy from shops, not only tourist stalls.
Street food is cheap, often ¥5–15 a snack. Carry small cash and use WeChat or Alipay where accepted.
more_time: Add a day for the Stone Forest (Shilin): buses and trains run from the city; check times on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for a lake walk and the Western Hills near Dianchi.
Take a side trip to a nearby old town or ethnic village; ask your hostel about day tours.
